user_policy: Rare combinations of unusual PNG appearance and structural concealment indicators may be suspicious or hostile without recovering executable code. Ordinary photos/noise textures are insufficient alone.

detector.name: zsteg
detector.coverage: All zsteg known methods: bit counts 1-8, eight pixel iteration orders, available channel orders, LSB/MSB bit packing, prime-only and pixel-aligned variants, extra format checks. Initial probes are limited to 4096 bytes per method. wbStego and zlib detector candidates were extracted without this limit.
detector.conclusion: No confirmed hidden payload. Compression guesses fail decompression or lack a complete stream/checksum. All wbStego candidates lack a printable extension; some declared payload sizes exceed extraction capacity. Reviewed results are weak header/length coincidences or flat-pixel patterns. Positive text and compressed detector controls are recognized.
detector.limits: This is not proof against arbitrary encrypted pixel payloads, custom embeddings, or data beyond the per-method probe. No encryption algorithm is inferred from entropy.

checks.regressions: 14/14 PNG carrier layout cases passed, including expected suspicious/hostile criticalities.
checks.references: No external exact references to retired composite IDs or ancestor directory selectors affected; pixel thresholds and type/platform scopes preserved.
checks.validation: make validate still fails on the same pre-existing validator/taxonomy errors; no classifications or local originals moved.
